title_working: THE CEILING WAS IN THE MEASUREMENT
binding: The signal ribbon is the only hero. Its physical material must carry the distinction between measured, corrected, extrapolated, and unknown evidence at phone scale.

palette.world: A warm sunward instrument-space, moving from plum-black uncertainty to an ivory-lit correction without becoming default blue or an Alaska-night scene.

roles.signal: #FF2F6D solar rose, reserved exclusively for the embodied ribbon
roles.sun_key: #FFF0D1 solar ivory, verified type and directional key
roles.neutral: #A79DA1 warm nickel, source plates and evidence ticks
roles.uncertainty: #8D7C86 modeled ash, offset ghosts and unsupported geometry
roles.projection: #FF2F6D at 38 percent, dashed, hairline, and shadowless beyond 15 mV/m

palette.semantic_law: Supported evidence has an unbroken body, shaded form, rim, and contact presence. Uncertainty is an offset ghost. Extrapolation keeps the hero hue but loses body, shadow, and continuous edge. Unknown territory is a true void with a dashed boundary.
palette.divergence: The previous two films used cold slate teal, bone, brass, terracotta, cyan clouds, persimmon flare, spruce, violet radar, and chartreuse models. This run uses no blue, teal, green, weather collage, or civic threshold. It is a horizontal path film in aubergine, rose, ivory, graphite, and ash.

light.time_of_day: abstract sunward twilight, explicitly not terrestrial Alaska night
light.direction: cause travels upper-left to lower-right from Sun toward Earth
light.key: hard solar ivory from upper-left at about thirty-five degrees, catching ribbon crest and monitor edges
light.fill: low plum fill from lower-right at about one-third key intensity
light.rim: ivory rim on embodied ribbon and apparatus; the modeled segment loses rim at 15 mV/m
light.depth_approach: four planes: monitor booms foreground, ribbon middle, Earth response deep, sparse particulate far field. Slow Stage3D dollies travel along the path rather than orbiting decorative space.
light.why: The viewer should feel a physical signal become less physical exactly where the evidence ends.

shape_language.thesis: A continuous organic curve meets rigid measurement hardware.
shape_language.hero: The ribbon is tapered, elastic, and capable of fraying into phase echoes and amplitude displacement without changing identity.
shape_language.counterform: UpstreamMonitor and the false ceiling are faceless, orthogonal, mechanically exact, and assembled from misregistered ticks.
shape_language.evidence: Solid through 15, dashed toward 25, and open beyond it. The ceiling is an obstacle produced by mismatches, never a second hero.
shape_language.why: Organic continuity keeps wonder alive while the rigid apparatus makes statistical bias visible as a mechanism.

casting.hero: SignalRibbon, this episode's configured instance of the reusable EvidenceTrace engine primitive
casting.throughline_object: SignalRibbon in five states: clean, matched, frayed, recalibrated, solid-to-dashed
supporting_from_shelf: Simulated for the inherited nonlinear model shape
ClaimChip for source-bounded projection and attributed interpretation
Stage3D, Atmosphere, CameraMoves, Plate, Nameplate, and EndCredits
casting.net_new_gap: UpstreamMonitor, the only net-new cast asset: a visibly SCHEMATIC, faceless non-character representation of upstream solar-wind sampling with timing teeth, magnitude jaws, booms, solar panels, and antenna geometry. It is not SatelliteEye and never implies imaging or AI behavior.
casting.why: The shelf has model and evidence grammar but no truthful upstream monitor or one-object path continuity for this mechanism.

motion_language.grammar: elastic tension, controlled fray, reweave, and material loss rather than noisy particle chaos
hero_moves: four-frame recoil before the opening whip, followed by a three-frame overshoot against PHYSICS?
timing uncertainty creates longitudinal echoes while magnitude uncertainty stretches width and crest height
calibration draws strands together, pauses two frames, then reweaves with an eight-percent elastic settle
at 15 mV/m the ribbon retains its arc but evaporates into a crisp dashed projection without a cut
the AI lattice flexes around the same blurred ribbon and returns it unchanged
motion_language.blur: one-hundred-eighty-degree directional trailing ghosts only on physical ribbon travel; type, boundary labels, and extrapolated geometry remain crisp
motion_language.camera: slow push on every hold, with one decisive dolly-through the fray and one pullback from ribbon scale to the full AI lattice
motion_language.why: Motion preserves a single continuous thought and makes the evidence-state transition happen as an event, not a disclaimer.

composition.focal_hierarchy: One dominant ribbon action plus one short source or claim plate per beat.
composition.vertical_safe: Ribbon lives inside the central sixty-two percent. The monitor occupies upper-left and the Earth response lower-right; labels alternate on outer rails above the caption band.
composition.square_safe: The protected central square contains monitor, fray, reweave, 15 boundary, and dashed 25 extension. Outer plates re-stack rather than crop.
composition.signature_shot: Inside S8, one unbroken three-quarter cutaway rides the embodied ribbon into the 15 mV/m stop, then tracks the same arc as it loses form, rim, shadow, and continuous edge toward 25 mV/m with EXTRAPOLATED and approximately two-times physically attached. The preceding calibration release is a distinct shot and is not falsely described as part of this oner.
composition.negative_space: The true void beyond the 15 boundary is the largest empty space in the film.
composition.why: The signature shot lets a muted viewer read the entire argument from material change alone.

claim_safety.wind: The distance plate says WIND TODAY and is visually separated from the 1995 TO 2019 date-range field.
claim_safety.projection: Every 25 mV/m and approximately two-times appearance carries EXTRAPOLATED and PROJECTED GEOMAGNETIC RESPONSE in the same object.
claim_safety.ai: The flexible-lattice beat carries NO OPERATIONAL AI TESTED.
claim_safety.alaska: AlaskaMini identifies UAF participation only. A persistent closing plate says NO FORECAST, NO CURRENT ALERT, NO ALASKA DATA SET.

craft_advance.name: EvidenceTrace
craft_advance.contract: A reusable continuous SVG path renderer whose segments can be observed, propagated-uncertain, calibrated, extrapolated, or unknown while preserving arc-length phase across fray, reweave, morph, glow, and dash transitions.
craft_advance.quality: Observed segments receive form shading, rim, and motion blur. Uncertainty adds phase or amplitude displacement without replacing the source path. Extrapolated segments become automatically shadowless, hairline, and dashed.
craft_advance.why: Future signal, current, river-flow, migration, and data-pipeline stories can change epistemic state along one throughline without swapping objects or painting a projection as an observation.
